title: Why Do We Yawn?
hook: A yawn is a big slow breath.
narration: A yawn is a big slow breath.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Yawn.
Your body may want extra air or a stretch.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Yawns can spread when you see one.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
It is a sleepy signal, not a scare.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A yawn is a big slow breath.
The pictures today are a new heart world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we yawn.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
